name: Triage Google Play reviews with AI: urgent Slack alerts, daily digest and Google Sheets log

parameters.content:
## Triage Google Play reviews with AI: urgent Slack alerts, daily digest and Google Sheets log

### How it works

This workflow runs every morning to retrieve recent Google Play reviews via an Apify actor, filter for new reviews, and use Claude-powered AI extraction to classify and triage them. It logs the enriched review data to Google Sheets, sends immediate Slack alerts for urgent or high-priority reviews, and posts a grouped daily digest for the remaining reviews. A separate lower branch checks app-level rating and release summary warnings and posts them to Slack even when there are no new reviews.

### Setup steps

- Configure the schedule trigger for the desired morning run time and timezone.
- Create a Header Auth credential for Apify (name `Authorization`, value `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`). In the Apify node, set `apps` (Play links, package names or app names) and `countries`.
- Configure Anthropic/Claude credentials for the AI triage node and adjust the extraction schema or prompt as needed.
- Create a Google Sheet with a `Reviews` tab and this header row: `date, app, appId, country, rating, version, category, severity, summary, review, replyDraft, language, reviewUrl, reviewId`. Paste its URL in the Sheets node.
- Connect Slack credentials and choose the channels for urgent review alerts, daily digests, and rating/release warnings.

### Why only new reviews?
The actor remembers what it already returned (`stateNamespace`), so each run you pay for and classify only reviews posted since the last run.

### Customization

Customize the filter criteria for what counts as a new review, the AI triage categories and urgency thresholds, the Google Sheets columns, and the Slack message templates or destination channels.

## Schedule and fetch reviews

Starts the workflow on a daily schedule and retrieves Google Play review and summary data from the Apify actor.

## Filter and AI triage

Filters the retrieved data down to new reviews, classifies them with the Claude model, and flattens the AI output back onto each review for downstream logging and notifications.

## Log and route reviews

Logs every enriched review to Google Sheets, then checks whether each review should be treated as urgent or high priority for alerting versus digest handling.

## Send review notifications

Posts immediate Slack alerts for urgent reviews and builds then sends a daily Slack digest for non-urgent reviews grouped by category.

## Post rating warnings

Runs as a separate lower branch from the review fetch to detect rating or release warnings from app summary rows and post those warnings to Slack.
